patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than VektorOS's shape. Choose VektorOS only if your buying job matches “Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.” rather than Linear's shape. Workflow advantage: Linear leans project-tracking; VektorOS leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual.; VektorOS is Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management..
- Company-size focus: Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market) vs VektorOS (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Linear-leaning project-tracking vs VektorOS-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; VektorOS — SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Limitations — Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise; VektorOS: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Poor-fit cases: Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · VektorOS is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency · Avoid Linear if you actually need VektorOS's motion (Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
